gaps.sentence: I really can't afford ___ on holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: afford takes the to-infinitive: can't afford to go.

gaps.sentence: This new timetable will mean ___ earlier trains.
We can't risk ___ the connection flight.
My parents wouldn't let me ___ out past midnight.
gaps.explanation: 'Let someone do' — 'let' takes the bare infinitive.

gaps.sentence: After introducing herself, she went on ___ the main findings.
gaps.hint: move on to a new activity
gaps.explanation: go on + to-infinitive = do something after finishing something else.

gaps.sentence: I've always wanted ___ how to sail.
It's high time we ___ this attic.
gaps.explanation: it's (high) time + subject + past simple (unreal past): time we cleared.
